title: Lazar's account deserves some probability if reverse-engineering programs exist

tellings.quote: Well, it's kind of intellectually disingenuous to say simultaneously I believe they're see covert reverse engineering programs and then also say the one guy with probably the most coherent story around having worked on a craft is 100% wrong.

plain: If secret programs to copy the workings of captured craft really exist, then Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on such a craft in Nevada in 1989, should not be dismissed as completely wrong. That is Michels' own argument: he says it is intellectually dishonest to believe in those programs and also claim the man with probably the most coherent story of working on one is 100 percent wrong.
